# NOTES ON THE TWO-BOOK TEXT (for later Q&A; text itself not needed)

## BOOK 1 of 2: "The Impostor" by Harold Bindloss (Gutenberg #39698; Ward, Lock & Co., London, Melbourne, Toronto)

**Chapters:** I Rancher Witham; II Lance Courthorne; III Trooper Shannon's Quarrel; IV In the Bluff; V Miss Barrington Comes Home; VI Anticipations; VII Witham's Decision; VIII Witham Comes to Silverdale; IX An Armistice; X Maud Barrington's Promise; XI Speed the Plough; XII Mastery Recognized; XIII A Fair Advocate; XIV The Unexpected; XV Facing the Flame; XVI Maud Barrington is Merciless; XVII With the Stream; XVIII Under Test; XIX Courthorne Blunders; XX The Face at the Window; XXI Colonel Barrington is Convinced; XXII Sergeant Stimson Confirms his Suspicions; XXIII The Revelation; XXIV Courthorne makes Reparation; XXV Witham Rides Away; XXVI Reinstation.

**Characters:**
- Rancher (Farmer) Witham (Frederick "F." Witham), English-born, ~26, grey eyes, bronzed face, prairie farmer in Canada (North-West/Alberta-Saskatchewan area), ruined by lost harvests, blizzard killed stock; mortgage foreclosure due August. Sold/wanted money. Saves horses by killing one injured horse.
- Lance Courthorne: gambler, whisky-runner, rustler, cruel, sensual; imperious; reputed to have ruined women; had Ailly Blake's brother Larry's shame; whipped by Shannon earlier (scar on cheek). Killed Trooper Shannon, then drowned/fled (survives, later dies after being shot by Corporal Payne in trail).
- Nettie: hotel-keeper's daughter at settlement; her father hotel-keeper (unnamed).
- Sergeant Stimson: grizzled NWMP sergeant; injured when horse fell at river.
- Trooper Pat Shannon: Irish, from Ontario bush; shot by Courthorne (in bluff, near Graham's Pool/river). Girl Ailly Blake, brother Larry Blake (farmer).
- Trooper Payne (English, later Corporal Payne).
- Colonel Geoffrey? No — **Colonel Barrington** (founder of Silverdale, autocratic, ex-army, slightly impoverished; late brother of Maud's mother's side; Geoffrey Courthorne was Lance's father, disinherited Lance, left Silverdale farm land to Lance; estate "Silverdale Grange").
- **Miss Barrington** (Colonel's sister, silver-haired, gentle, widow-like, knew Lance's mother; "Princess" nickname for niece).
- **Maud Barrington**: Colonel's niece, Miss Barrington's niece, ward, brown eyes, brown hair, proud, courageous; holds property at Silverdale; was in Montreal; Twoinette (friend).
- **Gordon Dane**: Colonel's chief lieutenant, big bronzed middle-aged bachelor; later helps Witham; sold wheat; friend.
- **Graham**: Winnipeg wheat-broker; later Witham's partner (St. Louis mills).
- **Macdonald**: farmer neighbor; wife Mrs Macdonald.
- **Alfreton**: young lad at Silverdale (speculated, later helps).
- **Ferris**: young English lad, Silverdale, gambler/loose; struck Courthorne's horse/fire (caused grass fire by starting it); banished; relative of Maud's family (connected).
- **Atterly, Carshalton, Allender, Lily, Hassal, Stapleton, Benjamin Nix (manager?—no, Nix is in Book 2).**
- **Mrs. Carndall**: gossip.
- **Twoinette**: Montreal friend of Maud.
- Lawyer (Winnipeg/Annerly) who met Witham as Courthorne.

**Key events (order):**
1. Witham at settlement; gets letters: foreclosure notice; friend refuses loan. Hotel keeper's daughter Nettie.
2. Witham drives home; team runs away down ravine; one horse dies (he shoots it).
3. Courthorne visits Witham's cabin; offers $100 for Witham to ride his black horse on Montana trail as decoy for police (Sergeant Stimson); Witham agrees, takes Courthorne's furs and cap; Courthorne notes scar.
4. Trooper Shannon (Irish, Ontario) recounts quarrel with Courthorne over Ailly Blake (Courthorne whipped him). Sergeant Stimson plans ambush at Graham's Pool / river bluff. Witham sets out in Courthorne's clothes, rides past troopers; Trooper Payne pursues; Witham escapes over bridge.
5. In the bluff: Courthorne confronts Shannon with rifle (F. Witham carved on rifle stock); Shannon struck, Courthorne shoots him twice; Courthorne rides into river, horse breaks ice; Courthorne apparently drowned. Shannon dying says "Witham". Witham implicated.
6. Maud Barrington goes to Montreal, returns to Silverdale with Colonel Barrington (Colonel meets her at railway station, Silverdale sleigh ride; Colonel says Courthorne's history; wheat price falling).
7. Witham (as Courthorne) hears lawyer's offer on Colonel's behalf — Witham accepts, goes to Silverdale; Dane and Maud; poker scene; Witham tells Dane he will sell wheat against Colonel's wishes.
8. Blizzard; Witham and Maud stranded in shanty; he gives her furs; she sleeps; he walks; she says "I am sorry" etc.
9. Witham persuades Maud to sow all her land; Colonel sells wheat forward; Witham builds bridge; ploughing; grass fire.
10. Witham's market speculation via Graham (Winnipeg); wheat rises; Silverdale saved.
11. Courthorne returns (feigning), demands money; Witham gives $1000, later reappears; Courthorne meets Witham at bridge; Courthorne tries to push horse off bridge; Witham saves him.
12. Witham's confession at harvest celebration; Courthorne appears wounded; Courthorne confesses to Shannon's murder to Stimson/magistrate (Harland); dies after Payne shoots him in pursuit.
13. Witham arrested by Stimson (acquitted later); Maud: "you will come back". Witham goes to Winnipeg; partner in St. Louis mills with Graham.
14. Reinstation: Witham returns to Silverdale; Colonel Barrington ill; Witham proposes to Maud; accepted; Colonel blesses match.

**Other notable phrases/items:** "Settling day" n/a; "Princess of the Prairie" (Maud); "Speed the Plough"; "Barragong"? no (that's Book 2). Ned? No. Ferris. "Lance Courthorne" stolen identity. Witham's $100 pay; $1000 to Courthorne; Courthorne's $500, $750, $1500 demands.

## BOOK 2 of 2: "Settling Day" by Nat Gould (Gutenberg #35496; R.A. Everett & Co., London, 1901)

**Chapters:** I The Little Chap; II Black Sal; III Potter's Shanty; IV Jim's Trouble; V A Regular Savage; VI Rodney Shaw; VII Outwitted; VIII At Cudgegong Station; IX The Sort of Man Dr Tom Is; X A Frightened Scoundrel; XI 'Try Willie'; XII Mainly Concerning a Dog; XIII Speculation; XIV The Half-Caste's Warning; XV A Cowardly Assault; XVI The Morning of the Race; XVII At the Post; XVIII His First Race; XIX Sal at Work; XX Danger at Hand; XXI A Clever Escape; XXII Determined Men; XXIII The Attack on Barker's Creek; XXIV A Fierce Fight; XXV A Stricken Woman; XXVI Settling Day; XXVII Neptune's Son; XXVIII Grey Bird is Admired; XXIX A Glorious Victory; XXX In the Days of Prosperity.

**Setting:** Australia, New South Wales; Swamp Creek township; Wanabeen (Jim Dennis's station); Cudgegong (Rodney Shaw's station, ~15 miles away); Barragong (police HQ, police magistrate Adye Dauntsey); Barker's Creek (Abe Dalton's gang's camp); Potter's Shanty (wayside hotel, old Samuel Potter); Gum Tree Hotel (Aaron Hyam, bookmaker); Bathurst trial; Sydney, Randwick (Sydney Cup).

**Characters:**
- **Jim Dennis**: outcast horseman, station owner, son Willie; wronged by wife Maud Dennis (deserted, went to England with Rodney Shaw, returned to die).
- **Willie (little chap) Dennis**: son, ~6 at start, 12 at races; jockey; yellow jacket & red cap.
- **Black Sal**: half-caste, ex-mission, freed from King Charlie's tribe (King Charlie, chief, curse); cares for Willie; later married Sergeant Doonan.
- **Dr Tom Sheridan (Dr Tom)**: Swamp Creek doctor, ex-ship surgeon, drinker, kind; dog Baalim (half-dingo mongrel); black boy (unnamed).
- **Constable Fred Doonan**: friend of Jim; later sergeant.
- **Sergeant Machinson**: corrupt police sergeant at Barragong, took money from Dalton; killed by Dalton; Adye Dauntsey (P.M.) investigates.
- **Ned Glenn**: coach driver, cheerful; killed by Seth Sharp (shot robbing coach).
- **Rodney Shaw**: wealthy squatter, Cudgegong; returned from England; Maud's ex-lover; attempted to abduct Sal; wounded at Barker's Creek; shot by Maud's... actually dies from bleeding after Jim confronts him. Shot in back by Doonan.
- **Benjamin Nix**: Cudgegong manager.
- **Abe Dalton**: outlaw leader, Barker's Creek; poisoned/shot Sal's ally black gin; killed by Machinson's bullet? — actually Dalton shot Machinson, then captured by Adye Dauntsey (shot hand) and hanged.
- **Alec Beg**: shifty Cudgegong hand.
- **Seth Sharp**: murderer, shot Ned Glenn.
- **Jackson**: jockey of The Captain (Dalton's horse).
- **Ben Madsley**: jockey of Distant Shore (Shaw's horse).
- **Aaron Hyam**: Gum Tree Hotel, bookmaker; son Moses.
- **Maud Dennis**: Willie's mother; died at Wanabeen.
- **Molly Corbold**: later Jim's second wife; cousin of Adye Dauntsey.
- **Chris Shaw**: Rodney's cousin, new owner of Cudgegong; sold to Jim.
- **Jack Ashton**: crack jockey (Defiance).
- **Hurley**: jockey of Target.

**Horses:** Bess (Jim's mare); Seahorse (stallion, by Fisherman out of Mermaid; Shaw's); Neptune (grey, by Seahorse out of La Perouse); The Captain (Dalton's); Distant Shore, Seaweed (Shaw's); First Class (Hyam favourite); Grey Bird (Neptune's son, out of Seamew); Defiance; Target; Tatters; Bung Bung.

**Key events (order):**
1. Willie (6) ill; Jim rides Bess to Swamp Creek; Dr Tom saves him; Sal nursed him.
2. Jim's backstory: Maud left him, deserted Willie, slandered Jim; "Settling Day" vow.
3. Potter's Shanty robbery: Jim suspected; Ned Glenn defends him.
4. Storm; stallion Seahorse (Rodney's) found in Jim's paddock; Constable Doonan rescues Jim; Sergeant Machinson suspicious.
5. Jim returns horse to Cudgegong; Rodney wary; Rodney's odd behaviour; memory "loss" claim.
6. Jim retrieves horse from Dalton's men at night; Shaw's manager Nix; Jim's horse-dealing.
7. Dr Tom frightens Dalton at Barker's Creek; Dalton swears oath to leave Jim alone.
8. Race preparation; Willie to ride Neptune (Ben Madsley had temper); Dr Tom secretary/starter.
9. Dalton's man Ben? — Dalton strikes Willie with pestle at Dr Tom's house; Willie concussed.
10. Dalton insults Willie ("half-caste") at Gum Tree; Dr Tom pushes him.
11. Swamp Creek Cup: Willie wins by short head on Neptune (fainted after weighing in).
12. Rodney plots to abduct Sal; Dalton's gang takes her to Cudgegong; Sal escapes via termite-eaten floor; black gin killed by Dalton.
13. Ned Glenn murdered by Seth Sharp; council; attack on Barker's Creek; King Charlie's tribe helps; Dalton captured, Machinson killed, Shaw wounded.
14. Maud Dennis returns to Wanabeen dying; Jim forgives; Rodney Shaw goes to Cudgegong, Jim confronts; Shaw dies of haemorrhage.
15. Trial at Bathurst: gang sentenced to death; Doonan promoted; Chris Shaw sells Cudgegong to Jim (for £12,000).
16. Grey Bird wins Sydney Cup (Willie on rails, short neck over Defiance & Bung Bung); Ashton's foul riding; broken stirrup leather.
17. Years later: Jim marries Molly Corbold; Sal married Doonan; Dr Tom prospers; Jim peaceful "autumn of his life".
